findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: The standalone HeatChill step represents aluminum-block preheating as an additional reaction operation without identifying its target. The following HeatChill step already represents the 80 °C reaction hold. Preserve the block preheating and reactor placement as unmapped actions rather than a second reaction-heating step.

findings.quote: chromatographic separation with silica gel (15% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)
findings.message: The Purify method records only chromatography. Preserve the specified stationary phase and eluent composition in unmapped_actions because the allowed Purify fields cannot encode these conditions.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: Placement of the microreactor into a preheated aluminum block is not separately representable by the allowed operations. The reaction temperature and duration are represented by the reaction HeatChill step.

value.evidence: chromatographic separation with silica gel (15% ethyl acetate in hexane as eluent)
value.reason: The allowed Purify fields do not separately encode the silica gel stationary phase or the specified 15% ethyl acetate in hexane eluent.
